title: A municipal parcels and utilities data model in GeoPackage, with a data dictionary and integrity rules

headline.label: of 7 deliberately wrong edits rejected by the rules

service.name: Spatial Database and Data Model Design

data: OpenStreetMap sample through the Overpass API on 2026-11-20: roads, buildings, power lines, street lights, fire hydrants and the district boundary in the box 24.732 to 24.748 N, 46.572 to 46.588 E.
method: Define the whole model in one table in the code: classes, fields, types, domains and relationships; everything is built from it.
Build a GeoPackage in UTM 38N and register the domains with the GeoPackage schema extension (gpkg_data_columns and gpkg_data_column_constraints) so QGIS and GDAL can read them.
Integrity rules as SQLite triggers: unique non-null keys, required fields, values inside the domain, and references that exist across tables.
Load the sample: roads as mapped, blocks derived from the road network, buildings linked to the block holding their centre, lights to the nearest road.
limits: OpenStreetMap holds no cadastral parcels or water mains here, so the parcel and water_main classes are empty and are filled from client data; blocks are derived from roads and are not legal boundaries. The quality of loaded data follows OpenStreetMap. The design is for a GeoPackage and does not cover server databases, user permissions or the Utility Network model.
